title: chat-filenode: name FileNode rights in role table
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 §Permission Mapping (Read/Create/Delete/Administer) grants no role mayRename on non-root nodes or mayModifyContent, so read literally nobody can rename/move/edit a Space file. crate-jmap (JMAP-v9py.16.4, Mark 2026-10-20) implements: manage_channels also gets mayRename + mayModifyContent; manage_space gets mayShare + root mayRename. Make the table name each FilesRights flag explicitly.
